main_topics.reason: The user opened with pain returning and said it was worst during the pill-free week.
The user asked for the full range of alternatives, compared several options, and asked what to try first.
The user raised concerns about irregular bleeding and whether GnRH treatment would feel like an unsupported menopause.
The user said they had been discharged to the GP after surgery and discussed seeking a specialist re-referral.
The user asked whether accessing pelvic floor physiotherapy would require going private.
The user said they were tired of treatment discussions always being about hormones and asked whether there were other approaches.

output.summary: The user described endometriosis pain returning on the combined pill, especially during the break week, and asked about alternatives, including options beyond hormones. The assistant discussed treatment choices, specialist re-referral and pelvic floor physiotherapy; the user ended with a list of next steps and said they felt less stuck.
